articles.title: Diamondbacks outfield prospect, 2024 1st-rounder, undergoes back surgery
articles.description: Diamondbacks prospect Slade Caldwell will be sidelined for four to six months after undergoing back surgery. The outfielder struggled this year in High-A Hillsboro, hitting .216 in 104 games.
